sloka: परिघाग्रेण पुस्फोट वातग्रन्थिर्महात्मनः।प्रजज्वाल सघोषश्च विधूम इव पावकः ।। ६.७७.७ ।।
transliteration: parighāgreṇa pusphoṭa vātagranthirmahātmanaḥ।prajajvāla saghoṣaśca vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.77.7 ।।

translations.english: By Nikumbha whirling around the club and the conjunction of the seven winds coming in contact with the club in his hand crashed in space and glowed like a smokeless fire burst forth.
